titulo: The Man Who Survived Two Atomic Bombs: Tsutomu Yamaguchi #shorts
premisa: You are Tsutomu Yamaguchi, a 29-year-old Mitsubishi engineer on a business trip to Hiroshima. On August 6, 1945, the first atomic bomb explodes about 2 miles away. It ruptures your eardrums, burns your upper body and blinds you for a while. You spend the night in a shelter, then catch a train home to Nagasaki. On August 9 you go back to work, still bandaged, and tell your boss that a single bomb destroyed a whole city. He doesn't believe you. At that moment the window turns white: the second bomb, again about 2 miles away. You survive again. Closing twist: around 160 people are believed to have lived through both bombs. Japan officially recognized only one of them, you, and not until 2009, when you were 93. You died a year later.
gancho: What are the odds of surviving TWO atomic bombs? This man did… and the craziest part isn't the second bomb.
